name: ta.sar
notes: Official pine_sar algorithm from the v6 reference: bar 0 is na; bar 1 seeds direction from close vs close[1], SAR at the previous opposite extreme; each bar applies the acceleration step, reverses when price crosses the SAR, advances the extreme/acceleration on continuing trends, then clamps SAR within the last two bars' lows (uptrend) or highs (downtrend). Uptrend-to-downtrend reversal on bar 4.
